headline: Claude integrates with Google Workspace, expanding clinical documentation reach
body: Anthropic's Claude now works natively within Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides, enabling real-time AI assistance across the Google Workspace ecosystem. For healthcare organizations, this integration directly impacts clinical documentation workflows, allowing providers to draft notes, organize patient data in spreadsheets, and build presentation materials without switching between platforms. The addition of Claude Code capabilities for automated modeling addresses a key vendor landscape gap: healthcare systems increasingly need AI agents that can autonomously transform raw clinical data into structured formats for EHR ingestion and value-based care reporting. This move signals a strategic shift toward embedded AI rather than standalone tools, which aligns with how health systems are consolidating vendor contracts to reduce operational friction.
